text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown got injured,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I thought I could do it if my condition was around this level, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, thankfully the injury is minor. I'm all right now!
Let's resume our training.”
choice_data_list: If we're going to do it while keeping a close eye on things, then...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No need to worry so much.
An injury like this is nothing I can't handle!"
choice_data_list: ...Didn't you say the exact same thing just a moment ago?
...Didn't you say the exact same thing a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Come to think of it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Not again... It's precisely when I have leeway
that I need to stay vigilant..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
I really am always like this, aren't I...

While engaging in deep self-reflection,
she spent her time resting peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I don't intend to overdo it.
Let's see, then we'll change the schedule and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's move on to classroom study.
There must be things you can do while caring for your injury!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now then, the documents are... placed pretty high up—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I-I thought... I could handle... this much at least...!!
To prevent the injury from worsening any further, I ordered Satono Crown to rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shall we discuss your training plan
for once your injury heals?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that sounds like a good general policy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: What! Is it really that time already!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Time flies when you're focused, doesn't it?
Since I stayed still, the pain from the injury has gone down too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've set up a solid post-comeback routine, too.
I think you'll be able to get some great training in!
